description: Run the arming pass the user asked for, in the user's time zone. 1) A scheduled "drop" task still armed from an earlier day is skipped automatically (missed); one armed today is kept; "reschedule" tasks stay armed. 2) Arms every active scheduled task due today that is not armed, except one the user already checked or skipped today. 3) Moves each active loop to its next task, except a loop whose current task is still armed and a schedule loop on a day outside its schedule. A second run on the same day skips nothing and does not bring back scheduled tasks checked or skipped today, but it still advances every loop whose current task is no longer armed (checked, skipped, unarmed or deleted since): not idempotent. Only when the user asks: arming is the user's act.
name: arm_all
title: Run the arming pass
